paper.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
paper.central_claim: Unbounded skill accumulation without lifecycle management causes library drift; trace-level diagnostics isolate it and retirement, a bounded bank and meta-skill authoring prior prevent drift, improve held-out performance and provide a non-divergence guarantee.

provenance.notes: Dispatched model type sonnet -> gpt-6.1-sol; no independent model receipt or session ID exposed; actual_model left null rather than probed.

sections_read: Complete supplied text lines 1–2183, §§1–8 and Appendices A–D including per-seed table and proof

evidence.quote:
Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term

library drift
: unbounded skill accumulation without
outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation,
false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent
evaluation confirms the symptom (LLM-authored skills deliver
+0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver
+16.2pp; SkillsBench
(
Li et al., 2026
)
), yet the underlying
mechanism has not been isolated.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors posit unbounded accumulation as the mechanism, not merely a training-free skill-library contribution.

evidence.quote:
A meta-skill document constrains the Synthesizer to produce
stylistically consistent skills. This addresses the “silent
injection harm” stage at its source: by enforcing structural
homogeneity, fewer harmful or redundant skills are born in the
first place, reducing the load on downstream retirement. Ablation
A3 (no meta-skill) shows that removing it costs 43% of the
Default’s gain; it is the single most valuable component.

Surprisingly, explicit deduplication mechanisms (pattern
canonicalisation, A5; cover-guard, A6) are
not
necessary
given the meta-skill: A5 and A6 slightly
exceed
the
Default. The meta-skill subsumes explicit dedup at this scale, a
design insight relevant to any system with LLM-authored artifacts.
evidence.support_explanation: Meta-skill is an authoring prior; explicit deduplication can be unnecessary, a useful negative result.

evidence.quote:
(i) One benchmark (MBPP+ hard-100); generalization to broader
domains (multi-step agents, SWE-Bench) is left to future work.
(ii) Single model (Claude Opus 4.7); cross-model stability not
established.
(iii) The diagnostic thresholds (when to intervene) are empirically
chosen; principled calibration is future work.
(iv) We hypothesize that drift signals (contribution scores,

hurt
verdicts) become more sensitive in multi-step agents
where per-step verdicts can isolate which step a stale skill
harmed; empirical validation is future work.
evidence.support_explanation: One benchmark/model; calibration and multi-step transfer remain future work.

evidence.quote:
Ratchet operates a five-phase loop per round:
(1)
Eval
: routes active skills on held-out tasks;
(2)
Train
: same pipeline on train split, generating
failure substrate;
(3)
Critic
: per-failure attribution verdict (LLM call);
(4)
Synthesizer
: clusters failures by canonical pattern,
authors new skills from clusters with
≥
\geq
3 members;
(5)
Curator
: computes contribution scores, retires
under-performers, enforces cap.
evidence.support_explanation: Eval and train precede critic and curator; text does not explicitly restrict curator contribution log to train-only capsules.

gap.author_gap: Growing LLM-authored libraries may stagnate or regress; existing systems allegedly lack outcome-driven retirement plus bounded cap.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete unanswered questions are which retained entries help and whether conservative retirement prevents harm. The paper shows injection matters and aggressive retirement can hurt, but does not isolate the asserted unbounded-accumulation causal chain. Prior novelty claims remain author positioning.

claims.text: Triggers isolate drift caused by unbounded accumulation and prove recipe prevents it.
claims.baseline/control: A1 no injection; A4 lower evidence floor and changed threshold; A7 doubles cap rather than removing it
claims.result/denominator: A4 negative rolling gain over3 seeds, only2 active skills
claims.allowed_conclusion: Routing is necessary for benefits and premature retirement may harm; no established causal reproduction of unbounded bloat or calibrated early-warning accuracy.

claims.text: Bounded cap and retirement ensure non-divergence relative to no-skill floor.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Not established: observational success imbalance is not treatment contribution, immature entries are exempt from retirement, average entry value does not imply taskwise improvement.

claims.baseline/control: Default vs no meta, no canon, no cover guard
claims.result/denominator: A5 gain0.374,A6 0.363 vs default0.328; authors acknowledge within2sigma
claims.allowed_conclusion: Useful conditional design observations, not statistically established universal rankings.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A frozen solver can benefit from a repeatedly reused skill bank on the stated train/eval split; over-aggressive retirement hurts across three seeds. Conditional practical result only, with unresolved evaluator-to-curator provenance.

Invalid steps in claimed safety proof; no actual replication or code execution performed

G.reason: Real governance problem and named lineage, but nearest neighbors unverified and central accumulation explanation not isolated.

M.reason: Concrete feedback-to-library mechanism and plausible cap/authoring fit; Eq2 does not support claimed treatment-bound guarantee.

X.reason: Router, synthesis threshold, retirement floor, cap and persistence reconstructable; safe admission/regression quarantine and immature-entry treatment incomplete.

E.measurement.reason: Executable MBPP+ outcome and explicit rolling metric credible for coding success; per-entry credit/LLM attribution not validated as marginal harm or early-warning diagnostic.

E.causality.reason: Injection-off and eight ablations informative; no uncapped/retirement-off control, two knobs changed in A4, and unmatched optimization budget limit causal recipe claim.

E.holdout.reason: 60/40 instance split is stated but repeated eval/gate data flow is not protected explicitly; no untouched final/category holdout or overlap/leakage test.

E.statistics.reason: Three evolution seeds, std and per-seed negative effects exceed single-run anecdote; no intervals/significance test and only40 repeatedly used eval tasks, one split.

E.cost.reason: Calls and wall time, including critic/synthesis, disclosed; no equal-total-budget null/alternative and no token/dollar accounting.

reason: Complete fixed main article and appendices; scoped practical evidence is sufficient to judge, despite a materially unsupported formal non-divergence argument and unresolved generality/gating controls.
rationale: 有完整三种子实验、留存技能消融与负结果；未隔离无界积累漂移，贡献分非反事实，安全证明关键推导不成立。结果限于单模型hard-100及重复留出集。
